Assuming “afternoon” means ~12:00–5:00, the two clearest afternoons are Thursday (nothing booked) and Friday (free after your 11–12 review — e.g., 1–3 or 2–4 would work).

If you want alternatives: Monday has a 12:00–2:00 slot (vendor call 2–4), and Wednesday has at least a 12:00–2:00 (or 1:00–3:00) slot (one‑on‑one at 3–4).
